name: nutrient-dws-mcp-server
description: Process, sign, redact, and transform documents from Claude Desktop using Nutrient.
long_description: A local Claude Desktop extension for document processing with Nutrient. It runs as a stdio MCP server, reads files from a user-selected sandbox directory, opens a browser for OAuth on the first request that uses the Nutrient API, and writes processed results back to local output paths.

tools.name: document_processor
tools.description: Convert, OCR, extract, watermark, rotate, flatten annotations, and process documents.

tools.name: document_signer
tools.description: Digitally sign PDF files with CMS or CAdES signatures.

tools.name: ai_redactor
tools.description: Detect and permanently redact sensitive content such as names, addresses, SSNs, and emails.

tools.name: data_extractor
tools.description: Parse a document into spatial elements with bounding boxes, or into Markdown.

tools.name: query_extraction
tools.description: Query a saved spatial extraction file by page, region, confidence, or element type.

tools.name: schema_extractor
tools.description: Pull specific named fields from a document into a JSON shape you define, with per-field citations.

tools.name: check_credits
tools.description: Check the current Nutrient DWS credit balance and usage.

tools.name: sandbox_file_tree
tools.description: Browse files available in the configured sandbox directory.

sandbox_path.title: Sandbox Directory
sandbox_path.description: Directory the extension can read from and write to for document processing.
